assets.description: Monthly payroll export files sent to the external accounting firm
Former employees' records retained after their departure

vulnerabilities.description: Access controls may not adequately restrict managers to records belonging to their own teams
HR staff accounts may have excessive privileges within the human resources system
Payroll export files may be transmitted to the accounting firm without adequate encryption
The external accounting firm may apply inadequate security controls to received payroll data
Retention and deletion rules for former employees' records may not be adequately defined or enforced

threats.description: A manager accesses contracts or performance reviews belonging to employees outside their own team
A malicious or compromised HR user alters employee salary or payroll information
An attacker compromises an office workstation and gains unauthorized access to the human resources system
An attacker intercepts payroll export files while they are being sent to the external accounting firm
A compromise of the external accounting firm exposes employee payroll data
A data breach exposes former employees' records that are still retained in the system
